scope: Independent read-only review of source identities, discrete variation, final code, actual fixed-cell execution evidence and source admission. Only review artifacts were written.

historical_campaign_provenance.independent_diff: DME changes only add recursive declarations. HF changes refresh the spectral flag and frontier chemical potentials/beta interval after final raw-field replay; no energy, pressure or SCF-trajectory expression changes.
historical_campaign_provenance.caveat: The launch-source audit is not the compilation manifest. The 28-cell campaign belongs to the retained historical source snapshot, not to the final source byte identity.

native_checks.scope: Discrete operator and functional checks. These checks do not authenticate source coefficients or establish nonlinear/global ground-state convergence.

diagnostic_campaign.scope: These are fixed-composition stationary-cell experiments. Failed uniform starts do not rule out other stationary states or minima.

literal_table_campaign.inference: A clustered iteration failure is not a proof that the literal functional has no stationary solution.

mesh_check.assessment: Material mesh bias remains. The single-cell trend is consistent with second-order refinement; it does not establish a converged EOS-wide error bound.

basis_extension.scope: Successful occupied-state truncation extension for this cell only; spectral_complete remains a cutoff sentinel, not a universal completeness theorem.

restricted_composition_check.assessment: Z=50 has the lowest energy within the declared fixed-A candidate set and beats its relaxed adjacent charges. No minimization over A, cell size, all shapes, all densities or all initial seeds was established.

final_binary_frontend_replay.old_vs_final_energy_pressure: The recorded decimal E and P strings agree exactly. Updated frontier quantities differ at the expected small final-replay correction and still exclude beta stability.

preserved_iteration_budget_failure.assessment: Different mixing/iteration budget explains why this run cannot be labeled converged. The final exact-prior-configuration replay resolves the apparent binary discrepancy without relaxing tolerances.

frontend_regression.note: The 11 frontend cases belong to the focused suite; do not add them to 140 as independent extra tests. The frontend does process orchestration/identity and never admits a ground-state EOS.

remaining_source_admission.scope: An admission census, not 672 numerical matching attempts and not a physical rejection of the pairs.

findings_disposition.HF-01: Resolved: native success requires status ok and converged; post-validation failures clear convergence.
findings_disposition.HF-02: Resolved for the implemented convergence contract: rho, tau, J and raw-field replay measured; unmeasured gradient zero removed.
findings_disposition.HF-03: One enlarged-basis check passed; all-density basis convergence remains an EOS-admission limitation, appropriately unclaimed.
findings_disposition.HF-04: Resolved: required success diagnostics and complete finite profile checked; malformed receipt regressions present.
findings_disposition.HF-05: Resolved on source readback: empty experiment identifiers rejected.
findings_disposition.HF-06: Resolved on source readback: seed enumeration and finite/range checks explicit.
findings_disposition.final_replay_reporting: Resolved in final source69c3; historical campaign retains its own snapshot.

scientific_blockers_for_original_or_grou: Original printed B/C/D coefficient identities are inconsistent beyond their rounding intervals; authentic author-intended correction remains unresolved.
D03x100 is a conditional diagnostic model and does not repair all identity conflicts or authenticate the author model.
Raw unsmoothed HF and the paper boundary-smoothing prescription are distinct numerical contracts; the unspecified gas averaging region prevents a literal smoothing reproduction claim.
Material mesh dependence, limited basis checks, restricted composition search and unresolved metastability prevent a global ground-state EOS claim.
Discrete dilation pressure validation is not the same as validating a fully minimized EOS branch and its interpolation, convexity and phase transitions.
privacy: No source PDF pages, user device identifiers, private backup locations or private numerical tables are included. Evidence paths in the accompanying report are project relative or logical archived-runtime locations.
